typed-card.jpg.title: Weeknight Black Bean Tacos
ingredientText: 1 (15 oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and chili powder and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the beans with a splash of water and simmer 5 minutes, mashing a few.
Warm the tortillas, fill with beans, and top with cheddar, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

cookbook-page.jpg.title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
ingredientText: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted, plus more for the pan
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the ricotta, milk, eggs, lemon zest and melted butter until smooth.
Fold the wet ingredients into the dry until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a griddle over medium heat and brush with butter. Pour ¼ cup batter per pancake.
Cook until bubbles form and the edges look set, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook 1 minute more.

two-page-1.jpg+two-page-2.jpg.title: Chicken and Rice Soup
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook until soft, 8 to 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock, add the chicken and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it with two forks and return it to the pot.
Add the rice and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

screenshot-1.jpg+screenshot-2.jpg.title: Peanut Butter Oat Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line an 8-inch square pan with parchment.
Stir the peanut butter, honey, butter, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Fold in the oats and chocolate chips.
Press into the pan and bake for 25 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Cool completely before cutting into 16 bars.

handwritten-neat.jpg.title: Nana's Banana Bread
steps: Mash bananas in a big bowl. Mix in butter.
Stir in soda + salt, then sugar, egg, vanilla.
Mix in flour (and nuts).
Pour into buttered loaf pan. Bake 350° about 1 hr till a toothpick comes out clean.

handwritten-messy.jpg.title: Aunt Rosa's Meatballs
steps: Soak crumbs in milk 5 min.
Mix everything gently with hands, don't overwork.
Roll into balls, brown in oil.
Finish in the sauce 30 min.
